messages:
Ellen (Product): Quick thread to agree on a customer-facing 'Network Covenant' and GA exclusions so sales can quote pilots without surprises.

Sam (Eng): Good call. Propose three lanes: Core GA, Network-Stable, Compliance. Keep Core small.

Dana (Field): Field request: a short install-time YAML the customer signs that lists VIP, LB type, and netops contact. We can require that for any IP-preservation promise.

Ellen (Product): Draft: Core GA = single-node operator, offline signed bundle, self-signed certs by default, documented minor-upgrade lane (no IP guarantee), opt-in telemetry, runbook.

Omar (Infra): For signed bundles we need a public signing key URL and rotation note. Ops can provision key this sprint.

Priya (PM): Network-Stable = multi-node HA operator, installer accepts network-covenant YAML (vip, lb_kind, cert_mode, netops_contact), installer validates reachability and stores a hash to enforce during upgrades.

Sam (Eng): Implementation: compute sha256 of covenant, store in operator config. On upgrade compare hashes; if changed, fail upgrade and surface remediation steps. Add an acceptance test that verifies VIP preserved across a patch upgrade.

Dana (Field): Add a clear customer sentence: "Changing the network covenant requires a maintenance window and may involve IP changes." Sales will copy that into SOWs.

Ellen (Product): Compliance lane = Network-Stable + BYOK/KMS, audit export, retention controls, security review gate, commercial agreement required.

Omar (Infra): Note: some CNIs don't preserve Service IPs reliably. We'll publish a supported-CNI matrix and a fallback guide.

Priya (PM): Prioritization ask: ship Core GA in ~5w, start Network-Stable covenant + validator in parallel (+3w). Compliance later after GA.

Sam (Eng): Rough efforts: Core GA 4-6w (1 eng + docs), network-covenant + validator 3w (extra eng). Need tickets and acceptance tests.

deploy-bot: ci: installer build queued (build-2026.06.11-1015).

Ellen (Product): Decision: ship Core GA with explicit exclusions; begin covenant schema + VIP plumbing immediately. Owners: Sam=GA lead, Dana=covenant spec & field comms, Omar=signing infra, Priya=sales one-pager. Sync Fri.

Dana (Field): I'll draft the covenant YAML and a one-line SOW blurb today.

Sam (Eng): I'll open tickets for validator and upgrade-lane tests.

Ellen (Product): Great. Keep the covenant short and unambiguous so customers know exactly what we will and won't guarantee.
